# Support

Start with the [reviewer guide](../docs/reviewer-guide.md) and [reproduction instructions](../docs/reproduction.md). Once the repository is published, use its issue forms for reproducible failures and concrete proof questions. No active Discussions channel, response-time commitment, or external scientific support service is claimed by this candidate.

Include the command, software versions, exact model, evidence path, and the smallest relevant output. Remove local account names and private data before sharing logs.
